info.title: Start here
info.description: IKON Tool is a command-line utility that is used for signing in, project creation, pipeline running, and more.

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Directory to download the app into (defaults to the current directory)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: auto, text or json (default auto: json when stdout is captured)

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the output to a file instead of stdout (json/csv only)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: App whose token the command runs with

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the current version of the IKON tool

options.name: --disable-auto-update
options.description: Do not update the tool before the verb runs

options.name: --log-debug
options.description:
Enable debug logging
Run 'ikon help env' for the environment variables the tool reads
Use this overview to find a verb or group, then 'ikon help <verb-or-group> --format json' for its contract.
The full inventory is large; save it with 'ikon help --format json --output ikon-help.json' when needed for tooling
